sources.author_creator: Adjutant General's Office; National Personnel Records Center; National Archives and Records Administration
sources.locator: Official unrestricted bulk file ASNEF.FIN.DAT; private identifier comparisons for four page-116 index rows; bulk record ordinals retained in restricted candidate evidence

sources.rights_notes: No raw bulk record, full service identifier, or Catalog API response is retained in this evidence bundle. An Army-entry occupation code is not a named employer.

claims.claim_text: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The visually checked index establishes a James E Devenney personnel-file row in Box 183; targeted official and employment searches yielded no corroborated prior employer.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Unresolved beyond the indexed name and file location.
claims.match_notes: Do not conflate this record with later namesakes found in directory and government-search results.

claims.claim_text: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index identifies Raymond M Devenuto as a second lieutenant with a Box 183 personnel file; accessible searches did not establish a pre-OSS employer.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Unresolved beyond the indexed name, rank and file location.
claims.match_notes: Modern directory hits for a similarly named person do not establish this wartime identity.

claims.claim_text: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index lists Jose M Deveraux as a sergeant in Box 183; no accessible source supplied an employer or an independent identity bridge.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Unresolved beyond the indexed name, rank and file location.
claims.match_notes: Preserve the printed Jose spelling and keep this row separate from Joseph M Deveraux Jr.

claims.claim_text: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index lists Joseph M Deveraux Jr. in Box 183. A private-identifier Army bulk lead differs in surname spelling, so the identity is not accepted without file-level comparison.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Ambiguous: the Army name DEVEREAUX JOSEPH M JR is a plausible orthographic lead, not a resolved match.
claims.match_notes: The differently spelled Army lead remains private and does not supply a named employer.

claims.claim_text: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The visually checked index lists Eugene N Devers in Box 183; the accessible searches did not produce a corroborated wartime identity or employer.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Unresolved beyond the indexed name and file location.
claims.match_notes: A genealogy-name hit is not documentary proof of the indexed person's identity or employment.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Ronnie A DeVico is a high-confidence match to Ronnie A De Vico in the official Army enlistment file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The independently published Army record and the printed OSS index agree on given name, middle initial and a private identifier not shared by another indexed person; only surname spacing differs.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from two official records and unique private identifier agreement; the physical OSS file is unreviewed.
claims.temporal_assessment: Army entry predates OSS service; the Army record does not name a civilian employer.
claims.match_notes: This is an identity link only, not evidence of immediate pre-OSS affiliation.

claims.claim_text: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The indexed file and Army entry provide identity context, but neither names a pre-OSS employer; Box 183 needs review.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence Army identity link; OSS file unreviewed.
claims.match_notes: Do not treat an Army occupation code or a cemetery-name lead as an employer.

claims.claim_text: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index establishes a Robert C Devilbiss personnel-file row in Box 183. A contemporary trade-paper lead names a captain of that name and a pre-service broadcasting job, but lacks an independent bridge to this index record and its full page has not been inspected.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Unresolved beyond the index; a matching full name in a search result is insufficient.
claims.temporal_assessment: The trade-paper chronology cannot be transferred to this person without identity confirmation.
claims.match_notes: Do not publish KLAC as this person's employer on the basis of a search snippet. Compare Box 183 and the original trade-paper page.

claims.claim_text: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The visually checked index lists Geraldine N Devine in Box 183; targeted official and employment searches yielded no corroborated employer.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Unresolved beyond the indexed name and file location.
claims.match_notes: Review the personnel file before assigning a profession, institution or namesake biography.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Gordon D Devins is a high-confidence match to Gordon D Devins in the official Army enlistment file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The Army entry agrees with the printed full name and a private identifier not shared by another indexed person.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from exact full-name and private identifier agreement across two official records; the OSS file is unreviewed.
claims.temporal_assessment: Army entry predates OSS service; its occupation code is not a named employer.
claims.match_notes: An unsourced genealogy name is not used as employment evidence.

claims.claim_text: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index and official Army bulk entry support identity, but neither provides a named civilian employer immediately before service or a documented military-to-OSS transfer.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence Army identity link; OSS file unreviewed.
claims.match_notes: Keep the indexed sergeant classification separate from pre-service employment.

claims.claim_text: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index identifies Peter P Devivi in Box 183, but the matching private identifier in the Army bulk file carries a completely different name; no identity or employer is inferred from that lead.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting official-record names require checking the index, bulk source and personnel file; the Army lead is not accepted as Peter Devivi.
claims.match_notes: The Army record's occupation code and name are not attributed to Peter P Devivi.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Only the visually checked James E Devenney index row is established; no external person-specific bridge was accepted.
person_updates.next_action: Review James E Devenney's Box 183 file for prior employer and OSS assignment.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The indexed second-lieutenant row and Box 183 are established; later Devenuto namesakes do not independently identify this person.
person_updates.next_action: Review Raymond M Devenuto's Box 183 file for pre-service work and the path into OSS.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Only the visually checked Jose M Deveraux sergeant row is established; it is distinct from the adjacent Joseph M Deveraux Jr. row.
person_updates.next_action: Review Jose M Deveraux's Box 183 file for identity and prior work.

person_updates.identity_evidence: A protected identifier agrees with an Army bulk row named Joseph M Devereaux Jr.; the surname spelling differs, and no file-level bridge has been reviewed.
person_updates.next_action: Compare Joseph M Deveraux Jr.'s Box 183 file with the differently spelled Army entry before adopting an identity or employer.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Only the visually checked Eugene N Devers Box 183 row is established; a genealogy-name hit has no OSS identity bridge.
person_updates.next_action: Review Eugene N Devers's Box 183 file for identity, entry chronology and employer.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index and independently published Army bulk file agree on Ronnie A DeVico/De Vico and a unique protected identifier; only surname spacing differs.
person_updates.next_action: Review Ronnie A DeVico's Box 183 file for a named civilian employer and military-to-OSS path.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index row alone is secure. A 1946 broadcasting trade-paper search hit for Capt. Robert C. Devilbiss has no independent Box 183 bridge and the full page remains uninspected.
person_updates.next_action: Compare Robert C Devilbiss's Box 183 file with the original April 15, 1946 Broadcasting page 88 before considering the KLAC lead.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Only the visually checked Geraldine N Devine index row is established; no external employer bridge was accepted.
person_updates.next_action: Review Geraldine N Devine's Box 183 file for identity, prior work and OSS role.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index and independently published Army bulk file agree on Gordon D Devins and a unique protected identifier. Neither names a civilian employer.
person_updates.next_action: Review Gordon D Devins's Box 183 file for civilian work and the military-to-OSS pathway.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index names Peter P Devivi, while an Army bulk entry sharing the private identifier names George W Delamarter; the records cannot be reconciled from accessible evidence.
person_updates.next_action: Compare Peter P Devivi's Box 183 file with the Army source and inspect for a shifted or erroneous index identifier before any identity or employer decision.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA index; CIA and LoC searches; James E Devenney OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, directory and archival checks.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Later government and directory hits have no wartime OSS or Box 183 bridge.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA index; CIA and LoC searches; Raymond M Devenuto OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, directory and archival checks.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Modern directory hits for Raymond M Devenuto Jr. contain no independent wartime identity or employer evidence.
research_attempts.research_notes: The index documents a second lieutenant, not a civilian employer.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA index; CIA and LoC searches; Jose M Deveraux OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, institutional and archival checks.
research_attempts.research_notes: No independent identity or employer evidence accepted; preserve Jose and Joseph as distinct source people.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA index and Army bulk; CIA and LoC searches; Joseph M Deveraux Jr. and Devereaux spelling variants, OSS, employer and archival checks.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Army surname spelling differs and cannot be adopted as a confirmed identity without the personnel file.
research_attempts.research_notes: Protected identifier lead retained privately; no named employer.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA index; CIA and LoC searches; Eugene N Devers OSS, employer, occupation, genealogy, newspaper and archival checks.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: An unsourced genealogy name and dates do not link to this OSS record or a prior employer.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA index and Army bulk; CIA and LoC searches; Ronnie A DeVico/De Vico OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, newspaper and archival checks.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: A cemetery-name hit supplies no employer or OSS file bridge and is not used for a claim.
research_attempts.research_notes: Official Army private identifier and name elements agree; no named employer.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA index; CIA and LoC searches; Robert C Devilbiss OSS, KLAC, Armed Forces Radio Service, employer, trade-paper and archival checks.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: A 1946 Broadcasting search excerpt has a same-name captain and possible pre-service KLAC job, but the full issue was inaccessible and no independent identifier connects it to the OSS row; it is discovery-only.
research_attempts.research_notes: Do not publish the KLAC lead. Inspect the original issue and Box 183.
research_attempts.next_action: Compare Box 183 and Broadcasting, April 15, 1946, p. 88.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA index; CIA and LoC searches; Geraldine N Devine OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, institutional and archival checks.
research_attempts.research_notes: No source with a person-specific employment bridge was accepted.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA index and Army bulk; CIA and LoC searches; Gordon D Devins OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, newspaper and archival checks.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: An unsourced genealogy profile names a Gordon D Devins but has no OSS identifier or employer evidence.
research_attempts.research_notes: Official Army full name and protected identifier agree; no named employer.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA index and Army bulk; CIA and LoC searches; Peter P Devivi OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, directory and archival checks.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Army bulk entry on the indexed protected identifier names George W Delamarter, not Peter P Devivi; the different person's occupation cannot be attributed to Devivi.
research_attempts.research_notes: Identity conflict is flagged without merging or adopting the Army occupation.
research_attempts.next_action: Compare Box 183, index transcription and Army source.
